attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Missouri corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus (post-Wayfair).

condition_details.condition_comment: Meets economic nexus threshold ($100K gross receipts); result.mo_gross_receipts is greater than or equal to result.mo_economic_nexus_threshold

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Missouri state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income. UNIQUE FEATURE: Missouri allows deduction of 50% of federal income tax paid.

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Missouri state additions and subtractions (including 50% federal tax deduction); Calculate state-specific income adjustments
action_details.action_dsl: set result.mo_state_additions = 0.0; if result.mo_us_interest_income != 0.0 then set result.mo_state_additions = result.mo_state_additions + result.mo_us_interest_income; endif set result.mo_state_subtractions = 0.0; set result.mo_state_subtractions = result.mo_state_subtractions + result.federal_tax_liability * result.mo_federal_tax_deduction_percentage; if result.mo_municipal_interest != 0.0 then set result.mo_state_subtractions = result.mo_state_subtractions + result.mo_municipal_interest; endif add (("Missouri additions: $" + string value of (result.mo_state_additions)) + ", subtractions: $") + string value of (result.mo_state_subtractions) to job.audit_trail; add "Missouri 50% federal tax deduction: $" + string value of (result.federal_tax_liability * result.mo_federal_tax_deduction_percentage) to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /result.mo_state_additions xdef { result.mo_state_additions result.mo_us_interest_income f+ cvd /result.mo_state_additions xdef } {} result.mo_us_interest_income 0.0 f== not ifelse 0.0 cvd /result.mo_state_subtractions xdef result.mo_state_subtractions result.federal_tax_liability result.mo_federal_tax_deduction_percentage fmul f+ cvd /result.mo_state_subtractions xdef { result.mo_state_subtractions result.mo_municipal_interest f+ cvd /result.mo_state_subtractions xdef } {} result.mo_municipal_interest 0.0 f== not ifelse "Missouri additions: $" result.mo_state_additions cvs strconcat ", subtractions: $" strconcat result.mo_state_subtractions cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto "Missouri 50% federal tax deduction: $" result.federal_tax_liability result.mo_federal_tax_deduction_percentage fmul cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Missouri corporate income tax. Applies Missouri flat rate (4.0%) to apportioned and adjusted taxable income. The 50% federal tax deduction significantly reduces effective tax burden.

condition_details.condition_comment: Has positive taxable income; result.mo_apportioned_income is greater than 0

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Missouri corporate tax (flat rate 4.0%); Apply Missouri 4.0% flat rate
action_details.action_dsl: set result.mo_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.mo_apportioned_income + result.mo_state_additions - result.mo_state_subtractions) and (0.0); set result.mo_tax_liability = the maximum of (result.mo_taxable_income * result.mo_corp_tax_rate - result.mo_state_credits) and (0.0); set result.mo_refund_or_owed = result.mo_estimated_payments - result.mo_tax_liability; add "Missouri taxable income: $" + string value of (result.mo_taxable_income) to job.audit_trail; add "Missouri tax liability (4.0%, effective ~3.6% after 50% federal tax deduction): $" + string value of (result.mo_tax_liability) to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: result.mo_apportioned_income result.mo_state_additions f+ result.mo_state_subtractions f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.mo_taxable_income xdef result.mo_taxable_income result.mo_corp_tax_rate fmul result.mo_state_credits f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.mo_tax_liability xdef result.mo_estimated_payments result.mo_tax_liability f- cvd /result.mo_refund_or_owed xdef "Missouri taxable income: $" result.mo_taxable_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto "Missouri tax liability (4.0%, effective ~3.6% after 50% federal tax deduction): $" result.mo_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No taxable income - no tax liability
